snippet.title: Call of the Elder Gods | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

30 years after Norah's adventure in the South Seas, Harry Everhart and Evangeline Drayton must journey through time and space to track down their lost loved ones and save an ancient race from the machinations of a secret cult. Solve puzzles with logic and observation in gorgeously-realised environments, from the firelit libraries of Everhart Mansion to the red deserts of the Australian Outback.

Call of the Elder Gods is based on Lovecraft's 'The Shadow Out of Time,' featuring returning voice talents Yuri Lowenthal and Cissy Jones, and a soundtrack by Call of the Sea composer Eduardo De La Iglesia.
